page.overview:
What is Maledoth?

The Maledoth was a former Yuuzhan Vong slaveship that was turned over to the Galactic Alliance after the Yuuzhan Vong War. The ship was eventually bonded with Wookiee Jedi Lowbacca, whom the Jedi Order hoped would assist with a Ramoan relocation project. However, Lowbacca left for the Unknown Regions, bringing the project to a complete standstill because no one else possessed his understanding of the ship's Yuuzhan Vong biomechanics.

The Maledoth was a huge during The Maledoth was turned over to the Galactic Alliance in the wake of the invaders' defeat at Coruscant

Following the devastation caused by the Yuuzhan Vong War, the new galactic power, the Galactic Alliance, established the Reconstruction Authority The former slaveship Maledoth was eventually bonded to the Lowbacca and the Jedi Knight used it to transport refugees to new homeworlds for many years. the Reconstruction Authority launched a relocation project to evacuate the Ramoan population from their dying world. The Jedi Order had been hoping to use the Maledoth to accomplish this purpose, however, Lowbacca, the only one who completely understood the biomechanics of the vessel, along with other Jedi Knights abruptly abandoning their duties and departing for the Unknown Regions. Without Lowbacca the project came to a complete standstill.

The ship Maledoth was first mentioned in the novel Dark Nest I: The Joiner King, which was written by Troy Denning In 2008, an entry for the Maledoth was added to a reference book The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia.
